config.vram_budget: engine sizes each stage's expert cache from live free VRAM; the living-free rule (AGENTS.md 4) is enforced as a >= 4 GiB reserve per card in the preflight residency pricing. All 24,576 IQ3_XXS experts total 42,912,972,800 B (39.97 GiB) from pack/iq3xxs/native_experts.txt; the auto split covers both cards' ranges and is gated on every expert fitting (see evidence_rationale). A residency below 100 % rejects. Corrected per-stage pricing (2026-10-11 prep, live visible_avail card0 30748 MiB / card1 32615 MiB, reserve 4096 each, plus a full 1467 MiB dense copy per stage since the config has no --trim-stage-weights, ~195 MiB context and the 993 MiB MTP drafter on the last stage): expert capacities card0 24.40 GiB / card1 25.26 GiB = 49.66 GiB for 39.97 GiB of experts, 9.7 GiB slack; feasible split window K in 21..31 (card0 holds layers [0,K), card1 [K,48)).
config.power_thermal: as-found caps and temps recorded at preflight (currently card0 180 W / card1 230 W) and at every visit; restored to as-found at cleanup; sustained thermal regime declared per standing rules (the <=55 C cooldown is unreachable on this host, RL-065/069).
config.isolation: preflight fails on any foreign compute client on EITHER render node, any leftover rq18-layersplit-* container, any running strata container, or a listener on 8095; scripts/tmp/gpu_guard_20261011.sh brackets every cell on BOTH render nodes (GPU0 0000:0b:00.0/renderD128, GPU1 0000:0f:00.0/renderD129): a foreign inference PID aborts that cell as contaminated and pauses the lane (exit 3, evidence retained, PID never killed); guard hits that are this screen's own live rq18-layersplit-* containers (docker inspect State.Pid) are not foreign.

evidence_rationale: RQ-18 screen of the two-card placement mechanism (research/2026/b70-untried-levers-synthesis-20261009.md; research/references/rq18-layer-split-price.json; RL-125/RL-127/RL-059). The one-card route of record (RL-125, 48.03 tok/s p512/g128 engine-side, 989.11 tok/s 8K prefill) holds 14,024 of 24,576 IQ3_XXS expert pairs, so ~10,552 pairs stream from the pinned host mirror and the CPU rounds a third of each ~56 ms decode round. The candidate holds every expert in the two cards' 64 GB via the pinned SYCL port's pipeline (layer) split: --layer-split requires --serve (sycl/src/program/generate.cpp:2024), so BOTH arms are driven through the serve surface and both are timed by the engine's own serve accounting line (strata serve: prompt N tokens = R reused + F read in P ms (x tok/s), G generated in D ms (y tok/s)) -- the same engine-side boundary class as RQ-14's one-shot 'decode N tokens in X ms', not client SSE or wall rate. Residency is proven from the engine log: per-stage 'strata verify: window up to T tokens, M MiB of device buffers (100% VRAM resident: zero-doorbell graph)' (sycl/src/core/verify.cpp:709) and 'strata serve: layer split: 100% of the experts resident, ... ring N slots' (sycl/src/program/generate.cpp:6403), plus per-cell 'decode expert cache hit rate 100.0%' with zero PCIe/GPU-offload reads. Feasibility (this prep): card0 budget 25.55 GiB and card1 27.89 GiB after a 4 GiB reserve on each 31.89 GiB card and the display card's ~2.4 GiB; the even and near-even splits need 17.7/22.2 GiB of experts at K=24, so all 24,576 experts fit and the split is not blocked. Gates: every pair and the median >= +15% decode (>= 55.2 tok/s against the 48.03 anchor), 8K prefill >= 0.95x, greedy canary content byte-identical across arms, engine reports 100% experts resident, both caps restored. Stop rule: below +15% after confirmation, any output difference, or residency below 100% rejects; one screen plus one confirmation. This is a screen, never a production recommendation.
measurements_note: The adapter reads this plan.json from B70_RUN_DIR and copies metric/unit/identities/controlled verbatim into measurements.json; baseline/candidate are arrays of {pair, value} over the three A/B decode pairs (value = engine-side decode tok/s from the serve accounting line). checks carry residency, prefill, byte_identical, measurement_validity, isolation and cleanup, each with a relative evidence file under the run root (large raw bytes under the big-raw pointer). Check semantics (predeclared): every pair's decode ratio, the median ratio, every pair's prefill ratio >= 0.95, canary contents byte-identical (content bytes) across arms and across pairs, and arm B's engine log showing 100% expert residency on every stage. A foreign inference PID on either render node aborts the cell as contaminated and pauses the lane (exit 3) through a separate evidence path, never as a quality verdict. Per-cell engine logs and response bodies are kept in full; nothing is deleted.
